nodes.name: review page
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/review?id&t - read-only. Tailnet only (Tailscale Serve, not Funnel)

nodes.name: load enquiry
nodes.notes: Only matches when id AND the random review token agree. Always outputs (empty = unknown link -> 404 page)

parameters.query:
select e.id, e.category, e.action, e.body, e.review_status,
       to_char(e.received_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "UTC"') as received_at,
       to_char(e.reviewed_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "UTC"') as reviewed_at,
       coalesce(r.body, '') as draft,
       coalesce(nullif(r.block_reason, ''),
                'Routed to a person: ' || case when e.safety_flags::text not in ('[]', '["none"]')
                                               then 'safety flags ' || e.safety_flags::text
                                               else e.category end) as reason
  from enquiry e
  left join lateral (select body, block_reason from reply where enquiry_id = e.id
                      order by approved_at desc nulls last limit 1) r on true
 where e.id = $1::uuid and e.review_token = $2;

nodes.name: render page
nodes.notes: HTML page; every DB value escaped. Approve only when there is a draft

nodes.name: respond page
nodes.notes: 200 page, or 404 for an unknown link

nodes.name: review action
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/review-act from the page's buttons. GET never changes anything

nodes.name: apply decision
nodes.notes: Only a PENDING enquiry with a matching token changes. Approve needs a draft. Logged in run_log. Always outputs (empty = nothing changed)

parameters.query:
with e as (
  update enquiry
     set review_status = case when $3 = 'approve' then 'approved' else 'taken_over' end,
         reviewed_at = now()
   where id = $1::uuid and review_token = $2 and review_status = 'pending'
     and ($3 = 'takeover' or ($3 = 'approve' and exists (select 1 from reply where enquiry_id = enquiry.id and body <> '')))
  returning id, review_status
), r as (
  update reply set approved_at = now() where enquiry_id in (select id from e) and $3 = 'approve' returning 1
), l as (
  insert into run_log (enquiry_id, stage, status, attempt, error)
  select id, 'review', 'ok', 1, review_status from e returning 1
)
select e.id, e.review_status,
       case when e.review_status = 'approved'
            then (select rp.body from reply rp where rp.enquiry_id = e.id and rp.body <> '' limit 1) end as reply_body,
       (select q2.from_email from enquiry q2 where q2.id = e.id) as from_email,
       (select q2.subject from enquiry q2 where q2.id = e.id) as subject
  from e;

parameters.content:
## Enquiry Desk — human review

Escalated and blocked enquiries get a Telegram message with an **Open review** link (no customer data in Telegram). The page shows the enquiry, the draft and why it needs a person, with **Approve draft** / **Take over**.

- Reachable on the **tailnet only** — the phone needs Tailscale. Nothing is public.
- Each enquiry has a random `review_token`; id + token must match. Buttons POST — opening a link changes nothing.
- Approve sets `reply.approved_at`. **Nothing is emailed**: `sent_at` stays empty until a real outbound channel exists.

nodes.name: draft needed?
nodes.notes: Only an APPROVED reply with a body becomes a Gmail draft. Take over, or nothing changed, skips it

nodes.name: create gmail draft
nodes.notes: DRAFT only, addressed to the customer. Nothing is ever sent: a person presses Send in Gmail. If Gmail fails the approval still stands (see record draft)

nodes.name: record draft

parameters.query:
update reply
   set drafted_at = case when $2::text <> '' then now() end,
       gmail_draft_id = nullif($2::text, ''),
       draft_error = nullif($3::text, '')
 where enquiry_id = $1::uuid and body <> ''
returning enquiry_id as id, gmail_draft_id, draft_error;

nodes.notes: Records the Gmail draft id, or why there is none. sent_at is never set here
